structured.reason: The "Tips for a Natural Blend" section fails the criterion through implication (category 3, defensive framing). It says: "Lightly mist your style with hairspray and a touch of dry shampoo to reduce the shine of synthetic fibers and help the bun blend with your natural hair." Reviewers complained that the product is "super shiny," "so fake looking," and "as obvious as a sock" in color, and that the donut "will show through." The tip concedes that the shine and unnatural look are weaknesses and reacts to those complaints. The rest of the description is positive: the fuller look, lightweight design, and styling versatility are plain claims with no caveats.
